text.text: Track every role and candidate from application to offer. Move a card across the pipeline as people progress, and log an interview right after it happens.
Every hire follows the same four steps so candidates get a fair and quick process.
Applied: a recruiter reads the application and replies within three working days.
Screen: a 30 minute call about motivation, experience and pay expectations.
Interview: a technical or portfolio round, then a team conversation. Two interviewers score each round from 1 to 5.
Offer: the hiring manager and head of people agree the offer before anyone calls the candidate.
Reject quickly and kindly. Record the reason so we learn which roles attract the wrong applicants.
Score each area from 1 (clear gap) to 5 (exceptional). Write one sentence of evidence for each score.
